headline: Measles outbreak: 1,009 deaths recorded as seven die in 24 hours
summary: Bangladesh reports 1,009 deaths due to measles and its symptoms since March 15, with seven new fatalities in the last 24 hours. A special vaccination campaign is set to begin.
details: The measles outbreak in Bangladesh has claimed 1,009 lives as of September 8, with seven new deaths reported in the past 24 hours. The Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) confirmed the latest figures, highlighting the ongoing severity of the epidemic.

Since March 15, a total of 1,009 deaths have been attributed to measles and its associated symptoms. Of these, 100 deaths are confirmed measles cases, while 906 are linked to measles symptoms, indicating a significant public health challenge.
In the last 24 hours alone, 1,194 new cases of measles were identified across the country. This surge in infections underscores the rapid spread of the disease and the urgent need for intervention.

To combat the escalating crisis, the health ministry has announced a special measles vaccination campaign scheduled to commence on September 25. The campaign aims to increase vaccination coverage and curb further transmission.

The DGHS has urged parents to ensure their children are vaccinated against measles, emphasizing that vaccination is the most effective way to prevent the disease and its potentially fatal complications.

headline: Oct 29: Thakurgaon-1 by-election scheduled for Mirza Fakhrul’s former seat
summary: The Election Commission has announced the schedule for the by-poll in the Thakurgaon-1 constituency following the vacancy left by Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir.
details: The Election Commission (EC) has announced the schedule for the by-election in the Thakurgaon-1 constituency, which was vacated by Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir.
Voting for the seat will take place on October 29, according to EC Secretary Akhtar Ahmed, who shared the information at the EC building on Thursday.
The schedule stipulates that nomination papers must be filed by September 27, with the scrutiny of these papers taking place on September 29.
Appeals against the scrutiny results will be accepted from September 30 to October 4, and will be settled by October 6.
The deadline for withdrawing candidacies is set for October 7, and election symbols will be allocated on October 8.
caption:
Thakurgaon-1 goes to the polls on October 29. The Election Commission has officially released the by-election schedule.

The Election Commission (EC) has announced the schedule for the by-election in the Thakurgaon-1 constituency, which was vacated by Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir.

Voting for the seat will take place on October 29, according to EC Secretary Akhtar Ahmed, who shared the information at the EC building on Thursday.

The schedule stipulates that nomination papers must be filed by September 27, with the scrutiny of these papers taking place on September 29.

Appeals against the scrutiny results will be accepted from September 30 to October 4, and will be settled by October 6.

The deadline for withdrawing candidacies is set for October 7, and election symbols will be allocated on October 8.
